title: 第2章 直奔刘邦军营
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

刘盈身体里边住着的，可不是一个十岁的灵魂，而是一个未来世界的青年！

他不仅知道吕雉和审食其有不正当的男女关系，更知道自己的便宜老爹刘邦知道他们有不正当的男女关系。

而且，刘邦对此事，完全就不在意……

若非如此的话，刘盈也不敢直接挑开了说。

吕雉面色一下子就变得涨红，目光闪躲着，面上却是故作威严，却低声道：“你怎可胡言？”

“娘，儿是不是胡言，娘自然知道，儿也到了成婚的年纪。”

吕雉一听，脸更红了。

刘盈这个时代，十多岁确实是到了成婚的年纪。

吕雉板着脸道：“那你去你父皇军中，需审食其领军，寸步不离的保护你，你能做到不乱跑吗？”

刘盈立刻起身，深深一拜，目光灼灼道：“娘只管放心，娘只有我一个儿子。儿子还想着长大了保护娘呢！”

吕雉听着这句话，眼里舐犊之情涌现。

这是还在她领着刘盈刘乐姐弟两人，为楚军生擒那段时间，刘盈对着她说的话。

那段随时都会掉脑袋的日子里，儿子那稚嫩的声音，留给了她极为深刻的印象。

“好，娘即刻让审食其领三千骑军，护送你去你父皇军中。”

吕雉立刻转头吩咐道：“即刻着审食其集结三千骑军！”

“喏！”

侍卫快速退了出去。

刘盈立刻说道：“娘即刻召集匠人和绣娘，用麻布和葛布，尽快的制作过冬的寒衣。

能制作多少，就制作多少。

做好了以后，就成批量的运送到军中去。”

“眼下已经到了冬季，父皇领军在北方征战，天寒地冻，军中士卒正是缺少御寒衣物的时候。”

“此外，再让人照着军中大汉手掌的形状，做出贴合人手掌形状的手套来。

这样的话，就算是天降大雪。

军中士卒只要戴上手套，握住兵器也不会觉得寒冷。

这样一来，完全可以保证我军中将士处在巅峰战力状态下……”

刘盈说着，随即又嘀咕起来：“对了，还有马镫这玩意儿！笔墨何在？”

他这边喊出话来，一边上立刻就有一个容貌清秀的宫娥，端着笔墨竹简走上前来。

刘盈立刻提笔把马镫的模样，画了简笔画！

“娘立刻着工匠打造这种东西，这种东西叫做马镫！”

“左右两边拴在马鞍上，方便军卒骑乘战马。

而且有了这马镫以后，军卒就可以手持兵器在马背上杀敌，照样如履平地！”

看着咬着笔头，正在思索着自己有没有什么疏漏的刘盈。

吕雉满脸错愕，却又满心欢喜。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

What lives inside Liu Ying's body is not a ten-year-old soul, but a young man from the future world!

Not only did he know that Lu Pheasant and Shen Shiqi had an improper relationship, but he also knew that his cheap father Liu Bang knew that they had an improper relationship.

Moreover, Liu Bang didn't care about this matter at all...

If this were not the case, Liu Ying would not dare to speak directly.

Lu Pheasant's face turned red all of a sudden, his eyes were evasive, but his face was pretending to be majestic, but he whispered: "How can you talk nonsense?"

"Mom, if you are talking nonsense, I will naturally know. I have reached the age of marriage."

When Lu Zhi heard this, his face turned even redder.

In Liu Ying's era, her teenage years were indeed the age to get married.

Lu Pheasant said with a stern face: "Then you go to your father's army and you have to scrutinize his leaders and protect you every step of the way. Can you do it without running around?"

Liu Ying immediately stood up, bowed deeply, and said with stern eyes: "Don't worry, mother, I only have a son. My son still wants to protect his mother when he grows up!"

Listening to these words, Lu Pheasant felt a feeling of licking the calf in his eyes.

This was what Liu Ying said to her when she led Liu Ying and Liu Le's brother and sister to capture alive for the Chu army.

During those days when she could lose her head at any time, her son's childish voice left a very deep impression on her.

"Okay, mother will immediately ask Shen Shiqi to lead three thousand cavalry troops to escort you to your father's imperial army."

Lu Pheasant immediately turned around and ordered: "Immediately review the food and assemble three thousand cavalry troops!"

"Here!"

The guard quickly retreated.

Liu Ying immediately said: "My mother immediately summoned the craftsmen and embroiderers to use linen and Gebu to make winter clothes as soon as possible.

Make as much as you can.

After they are done, they will be transported to the army in batches."

"It's winter now. My father is leading the army to fight in the north. It's freezing cold. It's the time when the army's sergeants and soldiers lack warm clothing."

"In addition, let people make gloves that fit the shape of human palms according to the shape of the palms of the big men in the army.

In this case, even if it snows heavily.

As long as the soldiers wear gloves, they won't feel cold when holding their weapons.

In this way, we can completely ensure that our army's lieutenants are at their peak combat strength..."

Liu Ying said, then muttered again: "By the way, there are stirrups! Where is the pen and ink?"

As soon as he shouted something, a pretty palace lady came up to him, holding a bamboo slip with pen and ink.

Liu Ying immediately picked up a pen and drew a simple drawing of a stirrup!

"My mother immediately asked the craftsmen to make this thing. This thing is called a stirrup!"

"The left and right sides are tied to the saddle to facilitate the soldiers to ride the war horses.

And with this stirrup, soldiers can hold weapons to kill enemies on horseback, and still feel like walking on flat ground!"

He looked at Liu Ying who was biting the end of her pen and thinking about whether she had made any omissions.

Lu Pheasant's face was full of astonishment, but he was also full of joy.
